# Author source provenance

Sparrow source, Cargo.toml and MIT LICENSE are preserved from [JeroenGar/sparrow](https://github.com/JeroenGar/sparrow), commit `7f069e9d146f5599d7ba69a47ab4e8097c56e54f`. Its Jagua Git dependency is pinned to `6e47329e4fd8dfe014428bd9045db132d26d35c9`. The author did not track Cargo.lock at this commit; the included lockfile records project dependency resolution and does not establish historical transitive dependency equivalence.

The Jagua 1.1.0 source archive is included under `jagua-rs`, retaining its MPL-2.0 license. Its source files are unmodified; the root workspace manifest omits the unused lbf member. Licenses remain specific to their respective sources.
